subject.statement: Carlos Ghosn s'est enfui du Japon en 2019.

summary: The claim that Carlos Ghosn fled Japan in 2019 is true (51% confidence). He was under house arrest awaiting trial in November 2019 and departed Japan in December 2019 by concealing himself in a box shipped as freight on a private jet, thereby violating his bail conditions. His full name is Carlos Ghosn (born 9 March 1954) and he held senior executive positions at Michelin, Renault, AvtoVAZ, Nissan, and Mitsubishi Motors.

findings.statement: Carlos Ghosn's full name is Carlos Ghosn and his known professional roles include CEO of Michelin North America, chairman and CEO of Renault, chairman of AvtoVAZ, chairman and CEO of Nissan, and chairman of Mitsubishi Motors.
In November 2019, Carlos Ghosn was under house arrest awaiting trial in Japan after his 2018 arrest on suspicion of financial misconduct at Nissan.

Carlos Ghosn departed Japan in December 2019 in a manner that violated his bail conditions, escaping by concealing himself inside a large box shipped as freight on a private jet while under house arrest awaiting trial.
